title: ZFS: Core types, validation, dataset ops, MockManager
description:
Implement ZFS manager foundation from docs/plans/09-sandbox-zfs.md.

Required reading: docs/plans/00-implementation-guide.md

Sections: §3 (ZFSManager interface), §4.1 (types + validation), §4.2 (error classification), §4.3 (dataset operations), §4.6 (MockManager)

Key deliverables:
- ZFSManager interface (18 methods) in internal/sandbox/zfs/zfs.go
- Core types: DatasetInfo, SnapshotInfo, PoolStatus, PoolSpace, DatasetOptions, DestroyOptions, RollbackOptions, SendOptions
- ValidateName() input sanitizer — defense against injection via dataset/snapshot names
- Error classification: ErrNotFound, ErrAlreadyExists, ErrBusy, ErrPermission, ErrInvalidName, ErrPoolFull, ErrNoSpace
- Dataset operations on CLIManager: CreateDataset, CloneFromSnapshot, DestroyDataset, GetMountpoint, SetMountpoint, GetDatasetInfo, ListDatasets, DatasetExists
- MockManager with configurable error injection for all interface methods
- Unit tests for all types, validation, dataset ops, and MockManager behavior

See Implementation Guide §1.11: ZFSManager is a pure ZFS abstraction — no agents, sessions, or tools. CLI-based (no CGo). All methods concurrent-safe.

comments.author: Danny Cosson
comments.text: Verified implemented in-tree (interface/types/validation/errors/dataset ops/mock + tests); go test ./internal/sandbox/zfs passes. Closing as complete.
